Subject: Demo request via pricing page CTA

Hi —

I was looking at Redwood's pricing page and clicked the 'Request a demo' CTA. We're evaluating inference providers for our analytics pipeline and have budget lined up for Q4. A few quick details:

- Company: Aurora Data
- Team: Platform / Data Infrastructure (3 people)
- Primary interest: production cost per token and latency for batch + streaming inference
- Preferred times for a call: Aug 12 afternoon PST or Aug 13 morning PST

Happy to share our scale (avg. 10k reqs/day, spikes to 80k) and some example prompts ahead of time if helpful.

Thanks,
Priya

Hi Priya —

Thanks for reaching out and for the details. I'm Lauren (SDR) on the Redwood sales team — happy to get a demo scheduled. Would any of these times work for a 45-minute call (we'll include a short technical section and an account review):

- Today Aug 12, 3:00–3:45 PM PST
- Today Aug 12, 4:00–4:45 PM PST
- Tomorrow Aug 13, 10:00–10:45 AM PST

If those don't work, send a few windows and I can coordinate. Here's a quick scheduling link as well: https://calendly.com/lauren-bishop/redwood-demo

Agenda (tentative):
- 10 min intros + goals
- 20 min product demo (serving/runtime, batching, cost controls)
- 10 min pricing and next steps
- 5 min Q&A

Looping in Marissa (AE) and Aditya (Sales Manager) so we have the right folks on the call.

Best,

Thanks — would prefer to keep it earlier if possible. Our team is available Aug 13 at 9:00–9:45 AM PST or Aug 14 at 8:30–9:15 AM PST. Also, can we make the demo a bit more technical? We'd like to see:

- Typical latency and variance on p95/p99 for streaming requests
- Batching and KV cache behavior for conversational workloads
- Examples of cost/throughput at 10k vs 80k rps (or guidance on how to estimate)

I can share a short sample prompt set and traffic profile if that helps the demo be targeted. Also, we'll have our Lead ML Engineer Tom Wilson on the call — he'll be cc'd when I forward the invite.

Thanks,
Priya
